ui.multiplayer_tasks_description: Complete tasks with your crew every day and earn EXP and cash.
ui.freelance_description: Freelance farming allows you to plant, grow, and harvest various crops at your own pace. Use tractors, harvesters, and deliver crops for rewards.
ui.livestock_farming_description: Feed your cows, collect milk, and deliver it to farmers. Manage animals for extra rewards and a different farming experience.
ui.melon_pumpkin_description: Prepare soil, plant melon or pumpkin seeds, water them, harvest, and deliver your crops. Each step brings unique farming challenges.

personal_challenges.personal_challenges_description: Complete farming challenges to earn rewards and increase the difficulty level.
